body.statement: For \(\kappa=1/2\), \(\eta=1/10\), and \(M=1\), there is an open neighborhood \(U_I\) of \(I_2\) contained in \(\mathcal K\) such that \(\mathcal P(\Sigma)=\{-1\}\) for every \(\Sigma\in U_I\), while each of \(A_{12}\) and \(A_{21}\) takes both signs across \(\mathcal F(\Sigma)\).
body.justification: This proves that graph-level polarity contains information absent from either edge sign on a nondegenerate region.
body.gap: vanSeeventerSalehkaleybar2026 establishes positive-measure edge-sign regimes but does not exhibit joint-only identification of a feedback product.
body.consumer: Qualitative feedback classification remains defensible when the direction of each individual interaction is not.
